archetype: ORGANIC & TACTILE COMMERCE (Archetype 1 + Tactical High Density)
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a high-efficiency POS and inventory management system designed for a Colombian grocery store ('tienda de abarrotes'). The design must feel grounded, tactile, warm, and highly functional with zero purple AI-slop. Provide dual light/dark capability or default warm high-contrast light mode with slate accents. Optimize the POS layout for touch screens (large numpad, big action buttons, instant search, camera barcode scanner dialog, receipt drawer). Integrate invoice photo upload OCR scanning simulation (drag/drop or mobile camera upload, image extraction preview with bounding boxes/detected items, instant import to inventory). Ensure touch target sizes are minimum 44x44px for POS operations. Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid AI slop purple gradients (#7351B7 is strictly forbidden). Use warm grocery-fresh emerald green (#15803D / #0F5132) and burnt terracotta (#C2410C) highlights.
Do NOT center align body text or main application containers. Preserve natural reading visual flow.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk font.
Do NOT use Inter font for Headings. Use Outfit or Plus Jakarta Sans for main headers, JetBrains Mono for prices/currency/barcodes, and DM Sans for readable body content.
Never use generic flat full-screen dark gradients. Use subtle tactile textures, crisp 1px borders (border-slate-200 / border-slate-800), and layered subtle ambient shadows.
POS screen must have 3 primary touch zones: Left/Top Navigation & Fast Categories, Center Grid/List with Search & Barcode Quick-add, Right Collapsible Cart/Totals/Numpad panel.
All interactive buttons and input fields MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='pos-checkout-btn', data-testid='barcode-scan-input').
Include responsive PWA/mobile navigation drawer or tab bar for small screen mobile operation.

components.pos_cart: Interactive list with quantity increment/decrement touch controls, discount applier, price calculation, payment dialog (Cash, Nequi, Daviplata, Card, Credit/Fiado).
components.ocr_invoice_uploader: Dropzone with camera capture tab, instant OCR processing status modal, table preview showing extracted items (Product name, Barcode, Qty, Unit Cost, Selling Price, Tax) with instant 'Confirm & Sync Inventory' action.
components.barcode_scanner: Webcam stream modal / input listener for standard Play Store scanner app hardware or camera reader.
components.sidebar_navigation: Categorized navigation list featuring standard active modules (POS, Inventory, Invoice Upload, Clients/Suppliers, Reports) and disabled badges for extended DIAN electronic invoicing modules.
